info.title: List Products SKPP Status
info.description: Batch query SKPP status for the seller's products.

post.description: Batch query SKPP status for the seller's products.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description:
The BCP-47 locale codes for displaying category information.
Default: The default locale of your shop.
Possible values:
- en
- en-GB
- zh-CN
- de-DE
- id-ID
- it-IT
- ja-JP
- ms-MY
- pt-BR
- th-TH
- vi-VN。

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

product_ids.description: Product IDs generated by Tiktok Shop; up to 100 per call.

skpp_status.description:
Optional filter. 
Possible values:QUALIFIED (already an SKPP product) / NOT_QUALIFIED (not yet meeting the standard, but eligible to take SKPP tasks).

page_size.description: Page number, starts at 1; used with page_size.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

product_id.description: Product IDs generated by Tiktok Shop

affiliate_program_status.description: Affiliate Program enrolment status. Possible values: ACTIVE / INACTIVE.

total_score.description: Current SKPP total score, as of update_time.

target_score.description: Score threshold to qualify for SKPP.

status.description: Possible values: NOT_GRANTED (below threshold, locked) / PENDING (qualified, not yet granted) / AVAILABLE (granted).

value.description: Granted amount/quantity; present only when status = AVAILABLE. Currency-typed (ADS_CREDIT) leads with the currency symbol (e.g. $15); count-typed (TOP_CREATOR_MATCHMAKING, SHOPTAB_PV) are bare numbers.

ad_credit_claim_status.description: Ad-credit-only sub-status, returned only when reward_type = ADS_CREDIT and status = AVAILABLE. Possible values: UNCLAIMED (eligible, not yet claimed) / CLAIMED (claimed). Ad credit must be claimed manually.

products.description: Product list, each with its SKPP status.。

update_time.description: Date of the offline data snapshot that total_score, rewards and the score breakdown are derived from, returned as a Unix timestamp in seconds, pinned to the last second of that date in UTC (23:59:59Z). The value is date-level only — the time component is always 23:59:59 UTC — because the SKPP scoring runs in an offline pipeline with no intraday granularity. Latency is typically T+1 (the evening of day N publishes the day N−1 snapshot) and at most T+2.
